title: Inbound event (owner -> a producer), normalized from any two-way channel
description: A button tap or a typed command. The hub writes it to the sink configured for its namespace: a queue directory the producer drains, or a command (e.g. an agent run, a CI CLI call) that receives this JSON on stdin.

schema.description: telefi.* is current; notifly.* is accepted while producers migrate

command.description: for kind=command: the word after '/', e.g. status

envelope_id.description: for kind=action: the message the button was on

raw.description: the channel's original update, for a legacy sink that handles it itself
